object_model: AppleScript: Word comments (author, comment text, scope text) and revisions (type, author, text object); accept/reject (revision k) followed by undo
thread_evidence: AppleScript exposes no reply link; whether a reply is shown in its parent's thread is read from the window screenshot: Word draws a threaded reply indented inside the parent's balloon (as in the Word-saved S2 source), and a separate comment as its own balloon
record: Excerpt of the fixability survey's Word check of 2026-10-10 (git-ignored tmp/fixability/word-check.json). Its protocol was written before the first file was opened and declared the anchor-replies and renumber-revisions pairs. The refusals of the Codex K5-S1 files were observed under that protocol; the single-change variants were made and opened afterwards, post hoc, to find the cause.
